'''Andrew M. Crouch''' is a [[Kimberley, South Africa|Kimberley]]-born South African academic who served as the second [[Vice-chancellor|Vice-Chancellor]] and Principal of [[Sol Plaatje University]] since [[April]] [[2020]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=OFM |title=Prof Crouch installed as new Vice-Chancellor of SPU |url=https://www.ofm.co.za/article/business/311658/prof-crouch-installed-as-new-vice-chancellor-of-spu |access-date=2026-04-28 |website=OFM}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title='Son of Kimberley' back to lead university |url=https://www.netwerk24.com/son-of-kimberley-back-to-lead-university-20200414-4 |access-date=2026-04-28 |website=Netwerk24 |language=af-ZA}}</ref> to 26 November 2025.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Bulletin |first=Noordkaap |date=2025-12-14 |title=Sol Plaatje University vice-chancellor steps down after transformative five-year tenure |url=https://novanews.co.za/noordkaapbulletin/sol-plaatje-university-vice-chancellor-steps-down-after-transformative-five-year-tenure/ |access-date=2026-05-19 |website=Noordkaap Bulletin |language=en-ZA}}</ref>

== Education ==
He completed his undergraduate studies at the [[University of the Western Cape]], where he earned a BSc Honours in Chemistry and a [[Bachelor of Science|BSc]] in [[Chemistry]] and [[Biochemistry]]. He holds a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in [[Chemistry]] from [[Concordia University]] in Montreal, [[Canada]].<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
Before joining [[Sol Plaatje University]], Prof. Crouch spent eleven years at the [[University of the Witwatersrand]] in various senior leadership roles, which included Vice-Principal and Deputy Vice-Chancellor.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" />
